scope: Closed HTTP provenance, all64 arithmetic and fixed descriptive contrasts only; no new acceptance threshold.
limitations: Four separate service launches per condition are not proof of statistical iid independence or a stable noise/tail distribution.
Every probe follows conditioning or another probe; none is an unconditioned cold1K request.
Ordinal and within-block neighbor balance does not guarantee wall-clock, temperature, machine-state or cross-block balance.
L8193 matches a historical direct predecessor length; the fresh service does not reproduce earlier accumulated request history.
HTTP/client arithmetic is not pure cache/CPU/I/O critical-path attribution, numerical tensor proof or54GB physicalRAM proof.
Canonical per-layer/cold/cleanup contracts are hash-bound and reused; this reviewer does not rerun their complete parsers.
SQLite token counters and complete SSE data are checked; no unretained HTTP status code is invented.
